{{Quote|I must've hit a ''force field--'' that set off this thing's ''vaporizer beams''!|Han Solo|<ref name="MSW22" />}}
'''Vaporizer beams''' were equipped on the [[Planetoid (weapon)|planetoids]] that served as hazards in the final round of [[the Big Game]]. While the planetoids exploded on impact, anything close enough to hit the proximity [[Force field/Legends|force field]] would cause the planetoid to launch deadly vaporizer beams.
